# Public local CA fixture

`caddy-2.10.2-root.pem` was generated by the Linux/amd64 Caddy binary extracted
from the shipped image pin:
`docker.io/library/caddy:2.10.2@sha256:c3d7ee5d2b11f9dc54f947f68a734c84e9c9666c92c88a7f30b9cba5da182adb`.

The selected image manifest is
`sha256:d8c17a862962def15cde69863a3a463f25a2664942eafd7bdbf050e9c3116b83`;
the binary SHA-256 is
`4ef1f68c70219536b2711fd16547a79841a2dec2d6b4e56b1e3e5e9da76028e6`.
Caddy reported version `v2.10.2`. An isolated native invocation provisioned the
ordinary `local` PKI authority with `install_trust=false`, admin disabled and no
listeners. All generated state stayed in ignored task storage, and the process
was stopped. Only the public certificate is retained here.

The fingerprint over original DER is
`b2f9010ee242c635c1e50be5faeb0ec51049d13c2731b68f4d9624a3d1940b61`.
The root uses P-256/ECDSA-SHA256, critical BasicConstraints and KeyUsage, and
noncritical SubjectKeyIdentifier. Typed parsing and verification of the
self-signature over the original TBS bytes passed before replacing the parser.
This is producer/profile evidence, not installed appliance qualification or
certificate-chain/expiry validation.
